title: Towards Alignment-Centric Paradigm: A Survey of Instruction Tuning in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper is a survey of LLM alignment and instruction tuning that treats ethical and moral reasoning as a central component of its evaluation and future research framework. It includes dedicated discussions (Section VIII) on evaluating ethical reasoning, moral dilemmas, and value pluralism (mentioning deontology), and includes 'Value-Aligned Prompting' in its taxonomy of prompt engineering techniques.
